name: detrend_breakpoints
expr: yd = detrend(x, 1, 3); a1 = yd(1); a2 = yd(2); a3 = yd(3); a6 = yd(6); ym = detrend(x, 1, [2 4]); m2 = ym(2); m3 = ym(3); Yd = detrend(M, 1, 3); q22 = Yd(2,2);
comment: detrend breakpoints (2026-05-30). MATLAB detrend(x,1,bp) does a CONTINUOUS piecewise-linear detrend (slope changes at each breakpoint, trend stays continuous); numkit previously IGNORED the bp arg and returned the plain single-line linear detrend. Replicates the classic detrend.m ramp-basis design matrix: bp=unique([0;bp;N-1]) (0-based offsets), one ramp column per segment ((1:M)/M over rows off..N-1, M=N-off) + a constant column, subtract least-squares fit a*(a\col) per column. Single bp=3 on x=[1.1 1.8 3.3 3.9 5.2 5.7]: a1=0.131578947, a2=-0.263157895, a3=0.142105263, a6=-0.126315789. Two bp [2 4]: m2=-0.131428571, m3=0.262857143. Matrix detrends each column (q22=-0.263157895). order-0 + breakpoints is a rare/ill-defined MATLAB edge -> DEFERRED (bp ignored for order 0). namespace=stats. Matches MATLAB R2025b.
